name: Frisk
description: Pre-install security audit and vulnerability scanner for ClawHub skills — 9 threat intel sources, 7 autonomous checks including malware scanning, dependency vulnerabilities, and credential leak detection.

binaryPath.description: Absolute path to the frisk binary. Defaults to /usr/local/bin/frisk (not PATH-resolved, to prevent hijacking).

allowExternal.description: Allow network operations: threat intel sync and remote repo cloning. Default: false. Enable only if you trust the agent to contact external services.
